summary: Iteration 53 (Phase-2 verification): validated the auto AI Analyst summary card on all 13 SAP dashboards + interactive flows. Frontend only. Login (cookie) POST /api/auth/login=200. 13/13 sap-insight-* cards render, each populates a headline + insight items (kind=fact/estimate/risk) + recommended actions from grounded GPT-5.4 within ~5-10s, and each sap-insight-run-<slug> Refresh button re-fetches (GET /api/sap/insight?focus=...=200). Interactive flows: /app/activation per-row Suspend->confirm dialog->reason->confirm-btn POST /api/sap/activation/set=200 and ua-status-<id> flips Activated->Suspended->Activated on Resume; ServiceNow ua-suspend-all opens ua-bulk-dialog and POSTs /api/sap/activation/bulk=200. sap-advisor-fab -> input 'suspend all active users' -> send: POST /api/sap/advisor/plan=200, sap-advisor-plan card + sap-advisor-plan-execute render; Execute -> POST /api/sap/activation/bulk (or set)=200. Normal question routes to POST /api/sap/advisor=200 (chat, no plan card). /app/sod: 72 sod-open + 72 sod-mitigate buttons; sod-open opens deep-dive; sod-mitigate opens sod-mitigate-dialog and mit-save POSTs /api/sap/sod/conflicts/mitigate=200; Simulator sim-person + sim-role + sim-add-role + sim-run -> POST /api/sap/sod/simulate=200 and sim-result renders. /app/privileged: priv-row-<ref> opens deep-dive modal (Critical RISK card with compliance alignment). /app/identities: id-search filters (Rossi -> 2 rows), id-row-<ref> opens id-detail modal. /app/monitoring: mon-tab-dormant/orphan/service all switch. /app/lifecycle: jml-leaver-<ref> opens residual-access deep-dive (6 containers, body text confirms). /app/hr-reconciliation: hr-reconcile-<personref>-<field> opens hr-reconcile-dialog; hr-save POSTs /api/sap/hr/reconcile=200. /app/roles: role-search filters, role-row-<ref> opens role-detail. /app/access-requests: ar-new -> ar-dialog -> ar-person + ar-role + ar-add-role + ar-justification + ar-submit POSTs /api/sap/access-requests=200 (ref=AR-0001); ar-approve-<ref> present for Pending. /app/certifications: cert-new -> cert-dialog -> cert-name + cert-create POSTs /api/sap/certifications=200; cert-card opens cert-detail. /app/systems: Connector Health page renders with SAP landscape table + connector cards + HR authority matrix. State reset via POST /api/sap/activation/bulk action=activate at test end.

design_issues.screen: SoD Command Center (and all AppShell pages)
issues: The persistent right-side 'Obserrian Advisor' sidebar (opened from the header 'Ask the Obserrian Advisor…' search bar) can overlap the action column of the Detected Conflicts table at viewport widths <=1600px, intercepting clicks on sod-mitigate-<ref> buttons. Works fine at >=1920px and via JS click. Consider auto-closing the advisor on route change, or making the main content shrink when the panel is open (currently it appears as an absolute overlay above table content on smaller desktops).

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Prevent the Obserrian Advisor side panel from overlapping right-column action buttons at 1440-1600px widths — either auto-close on route change or reserve layout space when open.
critical_code_review_comments: sap_uac.py remains ~1800 lines — still recommend splitting into modules (insight, activation, advisor, sod, hr, requests, certifications) per >700 lines guideline.

SapInsight.jsx auto-refires only once per mount via ranRef; navigating away and back re-mounts and re-calls /api/sap/insight, which is fine for freshness but each navigation triggers a GPT-5.4 call — consider a short in-memory cache per (dashboard, focus) to reduce cost on rapid nav.

Multiple deep-dive drawers render several nested containers matching [role=dialog]/[data-testid*=deep-dive] simultaneously (count=6 seen) — verify only one is visually active and the others are aria-hidden so screen readers/testing tools aren't confused.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 access request (AR-0001) and 1 certification campaign 'SDET Test Campaign Iter53' during flow. Mutated a couple of activation states + one HR conflict RECONCILED + one SoD conflict Mitigated. Bulk-activated all users at end to restore baseline (POST /api/sap/activation/bulk action=activate = 200, changed=0 final).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes are confirmed nested under /app: /app (Overview), /app/activation, /app/analytics, /app/sod, /app/privileged, /app/monitoring, /app/lifecycle, /app/hr-reconciliation, /app/roles, /app/access-requests, /app/certifications, /app/systems, /app/identities. SapInsight slugs match the requested testids exactly (sap-insight-<slug>). Cookie login works; do NOT click the 'Sign In' tab — submit via Enter in password field. If clicking table row-end buttons like sod-mitigate fails via Playwright at 1600px, use viewport 1920x1080 or dispatch click via JS (document.querySelector(...).click()) — the Obserrian Advisor sidebar can intercept. Endpoints for reference: HR reconcile -> POST /api/sap/hr/reconcile; SoD mitigate -> POST /api/sap/sod/conflicts/mitigate; AR decide -> POST /api/sap/access-requests/{ref}/decide; AR provision -> POST /api/sap/access-requests/{ref}/provision.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only design/UX suggestion is the Advisor sidebar overlap at narrower widths.
